content: Government College of Engineering, Tirunelveli (GCE-TLY) is an autonomous institution affiliated with Anna University. It is located in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu and is approved by AICTE and DOTE.
UG admission follows TNEA counselling. PG admission uses GATE/TANCET through the common admission procedure. Lateral entry is available for eligible diploma and B.Sc. candidates.
The college offers Civil, Mechanical, EEE, ECE, CSE, Electronics & Instrumentation, and Industrial Biotechnology programs as undergraduate courses, with several postgraduate programs as well.
Hostel accommodation is available with separate facilities for boys and girls. The published annual hostel fee is about Rs.14,350, excluding mess charges which are billed separately each month.
The principal office can be reached at 0462-2552450 and principal@gcetly.ac.in. The general college contact number is 0462-2552450.
The college has a placement cell that supports internships and job opportunities for students. Placement data and recruiters are published by the college on the placement page.
The college supports research, funded projects, and innovation activities through its research and development initiatives and departments.
